new_file_evidence.collision_claim: No official AIDLC host-projection receipt schema exists under schemas and the existing bridge and run-state schemas do not own host-specific copy/reference mappings, destination inventory, instruction identity, reload posture, or qualification.
new_file_evidence.no_owner_claim: The run-state schema freezes project-pack authority but cannot truthfully own host-specific projection state.
new_file_evidence.convention_cited: Official AIDLC authority artifacts use focused schemas/official-aidlc-*.schema.json contracts for distinct authority and mutability boundaries.

positive: A separate registered schema owns the complete immutable host-projection receipt contract before the host engine depends on it.

The receipt records host and adapter identity, fixed projection mode, frozen origin run-resolution and project-pack fingerprints, official and trust identity, complete source-to-destination mapping and hashes, instruction-block fingerprint, reload posture, qualification result, and receipt seal.
tailtrail-registry.json registers the new contract and focused registry proof validates both schema ownership and strict discoverability.
